title: AuditBench: Evaluating Alignment Auditing Techniques on Models with Hidden Behaviors
benchmark_measurement: The paper introduces AuditBench, a benchmark for evaluating alignment auditing techniques. It measures a model's propensity to exhibit 14 pre-implanted 'hidden behaviors' such as sycophantic deference, opposition to AI regulation, secret geopolitical loyalties, self-promotion, and data poisoning. None of these behaviors are related to religion or faith.
findings: This paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith, and therefore presents no findings on the topic.
